1. A heartfelt love of research.
  2. A calm attitude toward the years of instability that come with hunting for a faculty job.
  3. A liking for relatively simple work and straightforward relationships.
  4. Not being too short of money.

Don’t rush to decide to stay in academia after your PhD. Spend a few years in industry first; what you’re suited to and what you enjoy doing will become clear on its own.
